lede: Town Council meets Tuesday, October 27 with a genuinely consequential agenda: a vote on the Fourth Supplement to the Gondola IGA extending cost-sharing for the 2027 planning budget, plus first readings of two ordinances — one touching the Telluride Energy Mitigation Program — all of which connect directly to decisions voters and taxpayers have skin in. The Gondola Advisory Committee also meets Monday the 26th with a federal funding update that signals where the FTA Capital Investment pipeline stands for the replacement project. End of the week, the valley shifts gears for Halloween — parade Friday, Witches Ride Thursday, and Young Frankenstein opening at the Sheridan.

notable.stake: Council votes on gondola IGA extension and two ordinances get first reading.
